notes: The registered command row is available at POS_DEAD and level 0, matching the C table before do_parry's learned-skill gate (R1/R2/R5e).
An unlearned player receives the exact swordplay refusal and no later combat branch runs (R1/R3/R5e).
The command ignores its typed argument and checks the actor's current FIGHTING pointer, preserving the exact no-opponent response (R1/R2/R3/R5e).
A stale one-way fighting state reaches C's misspelled noone's-attacking-you response before equipment or RNG (R1/R5e).
A mutual fight without WEAR_WIELD emits the exact unarmed response and consumes no outcome roll (R1/R3/R5e).
The manual skill arm draws number(1,101) and emits the exact outmaneuvered text on failure (R1/R3/R5e).
Manual failure calls improve_skill, preserving the C learning side effect and subsequent deterministic combat stream (R1/R3/R5e).
Manual failure sets WAIT_STATE(ch, PULSE_VIOLENCE * 3), proven through the padded next combat pulse (R1/R3/R5e).
A successful manual roll sends the exact direct defensive-position line to the actor (R1/R3/R5e).
The victim-side TO_VICT act receives the exact every-blow line while the mob remains the combat victim (R1/R3/R5e).
The TO_ROOM act reaches a separate awake observer with C capitalization and CRLF delivery (R1/R3/R5e).
The arbitrary trailing words do not select a target; do_parry follows the actor's FIGHTING pointer exactly (R1/R2/R3/R5e).
Manual success sets WAIT_STATE(ch, PULSE_VIOLENCE * 2), and the next padded pulse is delayed accordingly (R1/R3/R5e).
Success marks the opponent IS_PARRIED and the following combat round consumes the one-round defense adjustment (R1/R3/R5e).
The autonomous fighter special calls the same native do_parry with subcmd=1 and is already owned by mob.fighter-parry; this player-command slice does not duplicate it (R5b/R5c).
